title: Wide and Slow
hook: A grain truck, swinging out for a gate you cannot see.
scene: A truck ahead doing thirty with a load and a slow-moving triangle. It drifts left, which on a two-lane looks like an invitation. There is a field entrance somewhere on the right that you have no way of knowing about and he does.

source.psdp_skill: Skill twelve: driving on rural roads
source.teaching_target: NEW: PSDP twelve Large/slow vehicles + DOL 4.8 agricultural vehicles.

image_brief.subject: a slow grain truck ahead with SMV triangle, drifting left as if inviting a pass; field gate unseen on the right; full-grid cage; carrier (hard-sided, wire grille door facing inboard, Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille, belt routed through the handle)
image_brief.foreground: worn black wheel, faded pink dash DARK/UNLIT, FULL-GRID welded steel mesh over the entire windshield (VI-009 cage canon) — not a low dash-level band; missing windshield cage is a hard FAIL; carrier (hard-sided, wire grille door facing inboard, Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille, belt routed through the handle)
image_brief.midground: grain truck rear and SMV triangle in the same lane; truck yawed slightly left
image_brief.background: Backcountry east of Ribbon — Pacific Northwest only (fir, moss, wet gray); one continuous stretch; no arid canyon, no high desert, no NYC/Spokane drift; fence line and field edge right
image_brief.read: the grain truck drifts left with an SMV triangle; a pass looks invited
extra_negatives: no ego already in the oncoming lane
no second person in the car
no cat loose on the seat
no digital speed readout reading as live speed
no missing carrier when cabin or cage is in frame
Ali alone — only VI-013 has a second person
no carrier door facing outboard/camera unless brief says otherwise
no empty carrier with no cat visible behind grille
no belt not routed through handle
no carrier door facing outboard toward camera
no low dash-level mesh band only
no desert GPS / arid nav HUD
no brightly lit dash by default

geometry.ego_lane_side: right half of a two-lane rural road
geometry.ego_nose_in_frame: plow points up-frame toward the grain truck ahead
geometry.oncoming_position: left half empty; no oncoming vehicle in frame

variation.forced: Act VI Claude overflow locks: PNW Backcountry east of Ribbon; full-grid cage; carrier SPEC verbatim; no Mya; dark dash; no seed

decision: He's moved left and slowed. What do you do?

options.text: Take the gap on the right — he's making room
options.result: He swung wide for a right turn into the gate. You put the Menace where the trailer is going.

options.text: Stay back until you can see his mirrors and know where he's going
options.result: You hold. His signal comes on late, the trailer swings, and the gate appears. From back here it was obvious.

options.text: Pass on the left immediately, before he slows more
options.result: Blind crest coming and a farm truck beside you. You cannot finish it. The pass dies unfinished.

options.text: Sound the horn so he knows you're behind
options.result: You make noise on a country road. He already knew. The horn did not buy you information.

debrief: Farm equipment makes wide turns at unmarked entrances. Make sure the driver can see you before you pass.
